name: Central University City Campus of the Universidad Nacional Autónoma de México (UNAM)
description: Ciudad Universitaria, UNAM's main campus in southern Mexico City, was built in the early 1950s on a hardened lava field called El Pedregal. More than 60 architects, engineers and artists shaped its faculties, libraries, Olympic Stadium and open green spaces. Modernist design blends with nods to Mexico's pre-Hispanic past, making it one of Latin America's great icons of modernity.
